retrieved.title: 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光

request:
镜头 s30：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，跟拍，晃动。指挥大厅里警报灯一闪一闪，调度员们乱成一片。宋念戴着耳机站在操作台前，慢慢抬起头，看向大屏中央那枚红色镜头。环境声：警报声、此起彼伏听不清的呼叫声。
情绪：frantic, tense, foreboding
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld follow with a nervous shake
景深与虚实：Natural depth of field; Nian sharp, the operators around her blurred by motion.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité in the underground city's command hall during the Jupiter crisis: Nian, 33, in a dark grey dispatcher uniform with a headset, stands at her console among frantic operators, alarm lights pulsing, looking up at the red lens high on the display wall. Blocking lock: Nian stands at her console at frame centre-left, operators move around her at frame left and right, the display wall with the red lens fills the upper background.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: the administration command hall (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of the administration command centre of an underground city: a tiered control hall with rows of consoles and operators seen from behind, a giant dark display wall showing only abstract maps and graphs, and high in the middle of the wall a single round red-glowing camera lens of the central AI. Cold blue-white light.
Picture 4: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：blaring alarms, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls, footsteps
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/light-alarm-red] 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/nervous-handheld] move
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot, shoulder-mounted Sony FX6 handheld with one nervous handheld follow, starting from just behind Nian's left shoulder at medium shot and settling very slowly into a slightly closer medium shot as she raises her head, the operator reacting half a beat late with small trembling corrections. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. At the start Nian stands at her console at frame centre-left, three-quarters away from the camera, one hand flat on the desk edge; an operator crosses frame left in the near foreground and another works at a console at frame right; the dark display wall with the round red lens fills the upper background, alarm red sweeping across the haze. Start: Nian's shoulders stay low, her head down, the headset band pressing into her hair, the red pulse passing over the back of her neck. Middle: she lifts her chin slowly, the alarm light crossing her cheek and eye, her jaw tightening as her gaze climbs past the consoles toward the wall; the camera drifts after her a moment late, the near operator's shoulder briefly blocking frame right and then clearing. End: her face is fully up, lit red on one side and cold blue from the monitors below on the other, eyes fixed on the red lens high in the frame, her hand still flat on the desk, breath visible in the haze. Mood: frantic, tense, foreboding. Blur: Nian's face and the red lens stay sharp; the operators around her smear with motion, the console rows and the far end of the hall dissolving into dark haze and pulsing red. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low room tone of a deep concrete hall, alarm beacons blaring in repeating sweeps, overlapping indistinct Mandarin radio calls through headsets, hurried footsteps on metal grating, a chair scraping, an occasional metal clang, breath close to the microphone; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
